newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Kabila's top official meets opposition chief - aide.
newsitem.headline: Kabila's top official meets opposition chief - aide.

text.p: Laurent Kabila's top aide met radical opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi in Kinshasa on Wednesday to discuss moves to form a government in the new Democratic Republic of Congo, opposition officials said.
They said Deogratias Bugera, Secretary General of AFDL alliance whose guerrillas took power in Zaire at the weekend, met Tshisekedi at the prime minister's office.

"They met for 55 minutes at the prime minister's office this afternoon," one opposition official said. "Tshisekedi came with proposals and Mr Bugera will be taking those proposals back to the AFDL leadership."
He added that efforts were continuing to bring Tshisekedi together with Kabila, who was leading consultations on Wednesday on forming a government a day after arriving in Kinshasa.
